decision_rule: Only treat current P0 as information-limited if close-P0, target-divergent pairs exist across multiple seeds after removing H1-only speed/steer-rate ambiguity.
failure_criteria: miner only repeats H1-close ambiguity without requiring P0 closeness
results come from one seed only
pairs are accepted without source diversity or target-distance reporting
oracle labels or hidden parameters are used as actor-like inputs
hypothesis: If P0-close target-divergent pairs remain, the current deployable actor input may be genuinely information-limited; if they disappear, M146 ambiguity was mostly caused by narrowing H1 too far.
success_criteria: mine or explicitly rule out P0-close, future-envelope-divergent pairs across at least three seeds
compare H1-close versus P0-close ambiguity counts
report target-distance thresholds, feature-distance thresholds, source diversity, and exported examples
record whether current P0 is sufficient for the next PPO/probe phase
